requirements.quote:
QUIC deployments SHOULD provide mitigations for stream fragmentation
   attacks.  Mitigations could consist of avoiding overcommitting
   memory, limiting the size of tracking data structures, delaying
   reassembly of STREAM frames, implementing heuristics based on the age
   and duration of reassembly holes, or some combination of these.
requirements.condition: When operating a QUIC deployment that could be exposed to stream fragmentation attacks.
requirements.required_behavior: Provide mitigations for stream fragmentation attacks; possible implementations include avoiding memory overcommitment, limiting tracking-data-structure size, delaying STREAM-frame reassembly, applying heuristics based on the age and duration of reassembly holes, or combining these measures.
requirements.why_checkable: Implementation configuration and behavior can be inspected or tested to determine whether at least one effective stream-fragmentation mitigation is provided.
